messages:
erin (docs): Quick heads-up 1 PR cascade touching migration and examples. Previews show missing anchors when files move before redirects land. PRs: #4988 (move migration -> /guides/migration/overview.md), #4991 (temporary redirects), #4994 (cleanup/rename examples), #4999 (SDK snippet fixes). Current failing preview: https://deploy-preview-4988--redwood-docs.netlify.app/guides/migration/overview.html#upgrade-3

sam (eng): Yep, classic race. Best pattern: land a tiny redirect first, then move the file, then clean up. Otherwise link-checker marks the preview as broken and reviewers get noisy CI.

pat (platform): I can open a one-line redirect PR and also flip the link-checker to WARN-only for a configurable short window during the merge. I'll also prepare a CDN purge command in case old path persists.

link-bot: [ci] deploy-preview-4988 failed: 1 broken link detected -> /guides/migration.html#upgrade-3 not found

erin (docs): Proposed sequence: (1) pat opens #4991 with the redirect mapping -> merge it; (2) merge #4988 (move); (3) merge #4994 (rename cleanup); (4) merge #4999 (snippets). Requesting reviewers: @sam for #4988, @mira for #4999. Target merge window: today 17:00-17:45 PT. Any objections?

mira (docs): I'll take #4999. Note: SDK renamed a helper; I'll add a short compatibility alias so examples don't break immediately. Also adding a short note at the top of the migration guide to help external links.

sam (eng): Fine with the plan. Local repro tip: run `yarn docs:build && ./bin/link-checker` to reproduce the missing-anchor error. Example error I saw:
```
LinkCheckerError: Missing anchor 'upgrade-3' in migration.md
```

pat (platform): #4991 created (WIP) with mapping: `/guides/migration.html -> /guides/migration/overview.html`. I'll mark it urgent and schedule a WARN-only flip 5 minutes before the window. If redirects don't appear in preview due to race, we may need to merge the redirect PR twice (race condition with the preview deploy). I'll also prepare `scripts/purge-cdn.sh /guides/migration.html` in case of caching issues.

erin (docs): I'll add the `docs/merge-window` label to all PRs, update PR descriptions with the merge order and rollback steps, and run `scripts/docs-smoke.sh --preview-url <deploy-preview>` after each merge to validate anchors. Rollback plan: revert last merge and purge CDN for the route.

sam (eng): :thumbsup: I'll be on standby at 16:55 PT to approve #4988. Please ping 10 minutes before.

erin (docs): Will do. Thanks team. If anyone needs to swap approvals ping here now so we can reassign before the window.
